description: Implement merge operations in GCT API: POST /api/v1/repo/merge (merge branch into current), GET /api/v1/repo/merge/status (detailed conflict information including per-file ours/theirs/base content), POST /api/v1/repo/merge/abort. Conflict reporting must include structured hunk data suitable for three-way merge rendering in the UI. Follow existing seam-based architecture with GitRunner interface for testability.
name: gct-merge-api
title: Merge, status, and abort endpoints with conflict reporting
